question: Can the TOP RGB detector recognise the catalogue cargo kinds (can, tile, long_beam, heavy_crate, tri_frame) among the four box colours, with kind, floor xy, yaw and confidence, without confusing boxes, floor paint or robots?
scope: Offline, synchronous SIM renders of zones/zone_wide with cargo re-posed per view (teleport + 0.6 s settle). Detection only; not wired to any controller or prompt. Ground truth only in eval-labels/. Not a robot skill or delivery success.

source.note: dev frames were rendered at 078cb73 with the evaluation script uncommitted (render code identical to 07a958d); dev and test were scored at 07a958d; test was rendered and scored once at 07a958d on a clean tree

execution_bundle: unchanged; no bundle registry touched, RUNNABLE_ID unchanged; new files are outside the bundle source closure (tested)

environment.host: Mac (shared with other agents; load averages recorded per step)
environment.agent_lock: not taken for offline synchronous rendering/scoring

definitions.paint: cargo on zone paint (zone C twice as likely), 80% of cargo
definitions.near_robot: a robot stands 0-6 cm outside an item footprint, arm folded or hovering
definitions.formation: robots at the catalogue approach poses of a pair item (beam/crate) or the trio frame, arms hovering over the handles
definitions.adjacent: boxes 3.5-8 cm from cans, tiles and crates
definitions.straddle: items across the seams between TOP views
definitions.robots_on_paint: robots standing on zone C/A/B and pickup paint

profiles.top_cargo_v1: new (opt-in): cargo kinds + boxes via top_zone_v2 minus box blobs on detected cargo

metric_definitions.visibility: per camera from segmentation: full = visible/projected >= 0.6 and not touching the image border; partial_frame = touches border; occluded = < 0.6; merged uses the best camera
metric_definitions.camera_match: detection pixel inside the item's visible convex hull (+4 px); same class preferred
metric_definitions.merged_match: floor distance <= 5 cm (box/can/tile), 8 cm (crate), 10 cm (beam/frame); same class first, then confusion, else duplicate/FP
metric_definitions.xy_error: estimated object origin vs true body origin (floor plane)
metric_definitions.yaw_error: modulo the kind's symmetry (tile/beam/crate 180 deg, frame 120 deg)
metric_definitions.grip_error: worst catalogue grip point error after best role assignment, grip points derived by grasp_handles() from the estimated pose
metric_definitions.fp_background: merged: robot (<=0.2 m of a robot), near_item (<=0.3 m of any item), zone paint region, floor

artifacts.backup: local only (gitignored outputs/); not a remote backup

tests.unit: tests/test_zone_cargo_perception.py 22 passed; with tests/test_zone_color_boxes.py and tests/test_zone_cargo.py 52 passed
tests.workflow_manager: 27 workflows; plan samples for zone-cargo-probe/zone-cargo-catalogue restored after the stack merge

failure_modes: can floor position biased +x by 2-2.6 cm in the washed-out west (colour mask covers ~60% of visible can pixels); test p90 19.6 mm
residual misses (can 4, crate 3 on test) all in the washed-out west/north-west near the cctv_top/cctv_top_north seam
a box inside the tri_frame triangle is suppressed as "box on cargo" (test: 1 green box); suppression should cover the frame bars only
beam centre bias up to ~24 mm when only one 12 mm lime end cap joins the span
tile yaw p90 3.7 deg, max 9.7 deg (17x11 px object)
unverified: heavy occlusion (best-view visible fraction < 0.6 only once on test)
merged beam one-end/partial centre modes (unit tests only)
lifted/moving cargo, same-colour items touching, other lighting or maps
confidence calibration (almost no false positives to calibrate against)
